tagline: Run declared Zoom stream reads, bounded module-specific direct reads including sensitive Cobrowse SDK sessions, approval-gated clinical-note and Quality Management interaction actions, and a redacted Customer Managed Keys Hybrid archival key action.

global_flags.name: credential
global_flags.summary: Credential name to use for the Zoom request.

global_flags.name: connection
global_flags.summary: Credential name alias used only when --credential is omitted; does not resolve pm connections.

global_flags.name: config
global_flags.summary: Connector config override as key=value; never pass secret values here.

global_flags.name: limit
global_flags.summary: Maximum records to emit from a stream command.

commands.summary: Read Zoom users through the declared ETL stream.
examples: pm zoom users list --credential zoom-fixture --limit 25 --json

commands.summary: Read meetings for one Zoom user through the declared ETL stream.

flags.name: user-id
flags.summary: Zoom user ID or email; overrides credential config user_id for this request.

examples: pm zoom meetings list --credential zoom-fixture --user-id fixture-user --limit 25 --json

commands.summary: Read webinars for one Zoom user through the declared ETL stream.

flags.name: user-id
flags.summary: Zoom user ID or email; overrides credential config user_id for this request.

examples: pm zoom webinars list --credential zoom-fixture --user-id fixture-user --limit 25 --json

commands.summary: List a past meeting's participants' Quality of Service summary.
commands.notes: Bounded Zoom read; fixed method and path with a typed required meeting-id path parameter.
examples: pm zoom qss meeting-participants list --credential zoom-fixture --meeting-id 123456789 --json

commands.summary: List a live or past webinar's participants' Quality of Service summary.
commands.notes: Bounded Zoom read; fixed method and path with a typed required webinar-id path parameter.
examples: pm zoom qss webinar-participants list --credential zoom-fixture --webinar-id 123456789 --json

commands.summary: List a past Video SDK session's users' Quality of Service summary.
commands.notes: Bounded Zoom read; fixed method and path with a typed required session-id path parameter.
examples: pm zoom qss session-users list --credential zoom-fixture --session-id abc123 --json

commands.summary: Get a user's AI Companion conversation archive.
commands.notes: Bounded Zoom read; fixed method and path with a typed required user-id path parameter. Response download-URL fields are redacted by the json_redacted output policy.
examples: pm zoom ai-companion conversation-archive get --credential zoom-fixture --user-id fixture-user --json

commands.summary: List the authenticated user's My Notes.
commands.notes: Bounded Zoom read; fixed method and path with no request parameters (the live artifact documents none for this operation).
examples: pm zoom my-notes list --credential zoom-fixture --json

commands.summary: Get a My Notes note's content, and optionally its meeting transcript.

flags.name: include
flags.summary: Include the associated meeting transcript in the response.

commands.notes: Bounded Zoom read; fixed method and path with a typed required note-id path parameter and an optional include=transcript query flag (explicitly documented in provider prose, unlike qss's response-only pagination fields).
examples: pm zoom my-notes content get --credential zoom-fixture --note-id note_abc123 --json
pm zoom my-notes content get --credential zoom-fixture --note-id note_abc123 --include transcript --json

commands.summary: List clinical notes, optionally filtered by owner and/or meeting.

flags.name: note-owner-user-id
flags.summary: Return only clinical notes owned by this Zoom user.

flags.name: meeting-id
flags.summary: Return only clinical notes associated with this meeting.

commands.notes: Bounded sensitive Zoom read. Only note-owner-user-id and meeting-id are explicit provider request inputs; response-only dates and paging fields are not CLI flags. The clinical_json_redacted policy redacts clinical-note content and identifiers.
examples: pm zoom healthcare clinical-notes list --credential zoom-fixture --json
pm zoom healthcare clinical-notes list --credential zoom-fixture --meeting-id 123456789 --json

commands.summary: Get a single clinical note by ID.
commands.notes: Bounded sensitive Zoom read with a typed required note-id path parameter. The clinical_json_redacted policy redacts clinical-note content and identifiers.
examples: pm zoom healthcare clinical-notes get --credential zoom-fixture --note-id fixture-note --json

commands.summary: Plan an update to a clinical note's completion status.
commands.risk: high: changes a patient's clinical note completion status through an approval-gated reverse ETL action
commands.approval: reverse ETL plan -> preview -> explicit approval -> execute

flags.name: is-note-completed
flags.summary: Whether the clinical note is marked completed.

commands.notes: Typed high-risk mutation; preview and explicit approval are required before execute. The clinical note ID is redacted in write errors.
examples: pm zoom healthcare clinical-notes update --note-id fixture-note --is-note-completed true --preview --json

commands.summary: List Quality Management automated evaluations.
commands.notes: Bounded sensitive Zoom read with no provider-declared request parameters. Response-only pagination fields are not CLI flags; identifiers and personal-contact fields are redacted before output.
examples: pm zoom quality-management automated-evaluations list --credential zoom-fixture --json

commands.summary: List completed Quality Management evaluations.
commands.notes: Bounded sensitive Zoom read with no provider-declared request parameters. Response-only pagination fields are not CLI flags; identifiers and personal-contact fields are redacted before output.
examples: pm zoom quality-management evaluations list --credential zoom-fixture --json

commands.summary: View one Quality Management evaluation.
commands.notes: Bounded sensitive Zoom read with a typed required evaluation-id path parameter; identifiers and personal-contact fields are redacted before output.
examples: pm zoom quality-management evaluations get --credential zoom-fixture --evaluation-id fixture-evaluation --json

commands.summary: List Quality Management interactions.
commands.notes: Bounded sensitive Zoom read with no provider-declared request parameters. Response-only pagination/date fields are not CLI flags; identifiers and personal-contact fields are redacted before output.
examples: pm zoom quality-management interactions list --credential zoom-fixture --json

commands.summary: View one Quality Management interaction.
commands.notes: Bounded sensitive Zoom read with a typed required interaction-id path parameter; identifiers and personal-contact fields are redacted before output.
examples: pm zoom quality-management interactions get --credential zoom-fixture --interaction-id fixture-interaction --json

commands.summary: Plan creation of a Quality Management interaction from a third-party download URL.
commands.risk: high: imports a third-party interaction into Zoom Quality Management through an approval-gated reverse ETL action
commands.approval: reverse ETL plan -> preview -> explicit approval -> execute

flags.name: download-url
flags.summary: Third-party URL from which Zoom downloads the interaction media.

flags.name: interaction-channel-type
flags.summary: Interaction channel; required when any interaction-info field is supplied.

flags.name: interaction-from
flags.summary: Caller phone number in E.164 format.

flags.name: interaction-to
flags.summary: Recipient phone number in E.164 format.

commands.notes: Typed high-risk mutation. Download URL and interaction-info fields are redacted in generic write errors; preview and explicit approval are required before execute. If any interaction-info field is supplied, Zoom requires interaction-channel-type.
examples: pm zoom quality-management interactions create --download-url https://files.example.invalid/interaction.mp3 --interaction-channel-type voice --preview --json

commands.summary: List live Cobrowse SDK sessions for an optional monthly date range.
commands.notes: Bounded sensitive Zoom read. The provider explicitly permits an optional monthly from/to date range; page_size and next_page_token are response-only fields and are not CLI flags.
examples: pm zoom cobrowse-sdk live-sessions list --credential zoom-fixture --from 2026-08-01 --to 2026-08-08 --json

commands.summary: List past Cobrowse SDK sessions for an optional monthly date range.
commands.notes: Bounded sensitive Zoom read. The provider explicitly permits an optional monthly from/to date range; page_size and next_page_token are response-only fields and are not CLI flags.
examples: pm zoom cobrowse-sdk past-sessions list --credential zoom-fixture --from 2026-08-01 --to 2026-08-08 --json

commands.summary: Get details for one Cobrowse SDK session.
commands.notes: Bounded sensitive Zoom read with a typed required session-id path parameter; session pins, user/session identifiers, display names, connection IDs, and IP addresses are redacted before output.
examples: pm zoom cobrowse-sdk sessions get --credential zoom-fixture --session-id fixture-session --json

commands.summary: List users from one Cobrowse SDK session.
commands.notes: Bounded sensitive Zoom read with a typed required session-id path parameter; page_size and next_page_token are response-only fields and session/user connection data is redacted before output.
examples: pm zoom cobrowse-sdk sessions users list --credential zoom-fixture --session-id fixture-session --json

commands.summary: Decrypt one Customer Managed Keys Hybrid archival data key.

flags.name: key-id
flags.summary: Provider-required Customer Managed Keys Hybrid key identifier.

commands.risk: Returns sensitive key material only through a redacted output policy.
commands.approval: Requires plan, no-network preview, explicit single-use approval, typed confirmation, then execute.
commands.notes: Requires an operator-provisioned Customer Managed Keys Hybrid credential with key_connector_base_url ending in /api/v2 and an environment- or stdin-supplied key_connector_jwt. The operation declares its own customer-hosted origin and bearer; it never reuses the ordinary Zoom OAuth bearer.

help_topics.name: provider-inventory
help_topics.summary: The Zoom provider ledger tracks 1,913 documented REST operations; Wave 1 executes three stream-backed reads; Wave 2+ adds bounded direct-read/write operations module by module (see #3915).
